description.p: Turn audio files and microphone recordings into text with local Whisper models. Speech recognition runs on your device without uploading audio. The desktop interface is built with GTK and libadwaita.

ul.li: Transcribe WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG/Vorbis, and M4A audio files.
Record from a selected microphone with live provisional text, input level and duration indicators, and separate Stop and Cancel controls.
Choose automatic language detection or a supported Whisper language, and provide optional recognition context for names and specialist vocabulary.
Edit completed transcripts, copy text, export TXT or original timed SRT subtitles, and replace or append subsequent transcriptions.
Download models with SHA-256 verification or use an existing local whisper.cpp model. Downloads and model copies support cancellation.
Use CPU inference or Vulkan acceleration on a compatible GPU in the Flatpak package.

description.p: Optionally rewrite transcripts through a separately configured llama.cpp server. Instructions and transcript text, not audio, are sent to that server when you request a rewrite. Results appear during generation with native Markdown formatting and can be copied or exported as Markdown or plain text. Stopping generation preserves partial output.

Model files are not bundled. Explicit model downloads require an internet connection and additional disk space; recognition can run offline once a model is available. GPU acceleration requires compatible drivers.

Transcripts and rewrite results are not saved automatically. TXT export includes manual transcript corrections; SRT export retains the original recognized text and timestamps. Preferences and prompts are saved locally as unencrypted text, while authentication tokens are session-only.

ul.li: Local audio-file and microphone transcription with CPU and Vulkan inference.
Editable transcripts, replace or append workflows, TXT export, and original timed SRT subtitles.
Verified model downloads, local model selection and copying, language selection, and optional recognition context.
Streaming LLM rewriting through a configured server, with Markdown display and TXT/Markdown export.
Saved preferences, keyboard shortcuts, text zoom, and warnings before discarding unexported text.
Linux Flatpak and Windows installer and portable ZIP packaging.
